lines.en: I press across the snow step by step.
The hem of my cloak is frozen stiff.
The ice crust on my shoulder creaks.
Snow reaches my calves.

lines.zh: 我走得很沉，雪地都在响
lines.en: My weight makes the snow crunch.

lines.zh: 我抬起手，掌心托着一块冰
lines.en: I raise a hand with a block of ice in it.
Every step leaves a pit.
I go around an ice-caked tree.
Cold radiates off me.
The ice on my shoulder slowly grows.
I break the crust on the snow.

lines.zh: 我一边走一边摇手上的冰
lines.en: I shake the ice in my hand as I walk.
The snowy plains are quiet at night.

lines.zh: 我朝着有灯火的方向走
lines.en: I walk toward the lantern light.
My breath becomes white mist.
I stand with my feet sunk in snow.
The ice in my hand has never melted.
I listen to the wind in the snow.
A crust of frost sits on my mantle.
A light burns in the distance.
I weigh the ice in my hand.
No other sound on these plains.
My shoulders rise and fall slowly.
A layer of ice has formed on my back.
I wait for a patrol to pass.
My shadow darkens the snow.
Cold air circles around me.
The clouds above me hang low.
I stoop and stare down at you.
You stand out sharply on the snow.

lines.zh: 我的手掌比你整个人大
lines.en: My palm is bigger than you are.
You should not be out at this hour.

lines.zh: 手上的冰没有要化的意思
lines.en: The ice in my hand shows no sign of thawing.
My cloak is covered in icicles.
I lift one hand slowly.
The wind carries my scent to you.
You are shivering too.
I look before I move.
My body sinks, then holds.
A slab of ice falls from my shoulder.
Half a step back, and the snow gives.
My cloak has been cut.
I make no sound.
A crack runs through my ice shell.
I am still standing.
The cold deepens another degree.
You struck hard enough.
I want only ice, not your bread.
This little is not enough.
You hold it too close, standing there.
I take nothing offered by others.
That is not how I work.
The ice in my hand is more use than that.

lines.zh: 你在雪里站了一会儿了
lines.en: You have stood in the snow a while.
I have no need of such things.
I crowd you aside.
My shoulder is hard.
That only made me pause.
My steps fling the snow up.
You fall back behind a trunk.
I raise a hand and block you.
A few shards of my ice shell fall.
That was far too close.
I will not move my foot in this snow.
I have been alone a long time.
I am the only one on these plains.
Such matters are nothing to me.
There is only ice in my hands.
I hold this stretch of snow.
The cold wind is my companion.
Do not come near; you will be frostbitten.
I do not understand these things.
The night is still long.
We each take our own snow trail.
Two fingers lift it easily.
Frost forms on it at once in my grip.
This has frozen brittle.
It is frozen hard, not food.
I throw it back into the snow.
It has frozen to my hand.
This is not what I seek.
I tuck it into my cloak.
There is nothing here worth taking.
I have seen you.
There is nowhere to hide on snow.
You are too far from the village.
This block of ice is big enough.
I hold your place in my eye.
You cannot outrun my ice.

lines.zh: 我不用靠近也能打到你
lines.en: I can reach you without closing in.
I am slow, but I do not miss.
You had best stay where you are.
I hear your steps in the snow.
My eyes have not left you.
You hide behind a tree.
Every step you take is loud.
I am working out the distance.
This ice grows heavier.
It is a long way to the village.
You have looked back twice.
My breath scatters the snow.
There is a snow slope behind you.
There is no cover on that slope.
The ice crashes down in front of you.
That threw the snow up.
I stamp one foot down.
Ice spikes rise from the ground.
You are shoved a long way back.
My hand rakes across your armor.
Frost forms on your armor.
That throw went wide.
The ice shatters on the ground.
I raise my hand again.

lines.zh: 雪原上夜里升起一块冰
lines.en: Ice rises out of the night snow.
The wind drives snow onto me.
First I looked at the lights.

lines.zh: 肩上的冰一层层结起来
lines.en: Ice layers onto my shoulder.
My breath drags out long.
The snow underfoot is packed hard.
A dog barks in the distance.
I pull my cloak closer.
As fire nears, my ice melts.
I slide down the snow slope.
Icy water soaks into my clothes.

lines.zh: 冲击把我脚下的冰都震碎
lines.en: The blast shatters the ice beneath me.
Something pins into my ice crust.

lines.zh: 那力量穿过冰壳打到骨头
lines.en: That force passes my ice shell to the bone.
Hunger outdoes even this cold.

lines.zh: 雷落在雪上，我全身一亮
lines.en: Lightning hits the snow and I flare white.
There is not even snow here.
